TRANSAXLE (TRANSMISSION) MOUNTING
TSB Revision
POWER PLANT MOUNT
32-8
REMOVAL SERVICE POINT
<<A>> TRANSAXLE MOUNT BRACKET REMOVAL
1. Install special tools MB991453 and MZ203827 to the vehicle 
body to support the engine and transaxle assembly.
2. Remove the centermember and rear roll stopper bracket.
3. Remove the bolt and nut of the transaxle mount bracket.
4. After lowering the engine and transaxle assembly, remove 
the transaxle mount bracket.
INSTALLATION SERVICE POINT
>>A<< TRANSAXLE MOUNT STOPPER INSTALLATION
Clamp the transaxle mount stopper so that the arrow points in 
the direction as shown in the diagram.
